title: misanteca aurea
intro: Misanteca aurea, commonly known as golden misanteca, is a species of tree in the family Lauraceae. It is a native plant to Central and South America, particularly in countries such as Costa Rica and Panama. The health benefits of Misanteca aurea include its ability to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions are attributed to its potential to lower blood pressure and act as an antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of Misanteca aurea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
